title: Jacobo Grinberg disappears a month after Puharich's death
summary: Unnamed guest tells of Jacobo Grinberg disappears a month after Puharich's death, about 1995 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um in '95, uh less than a month after Puharich dies, he this guy disappears, Grinberg.
and you know he goes missing and I think the last note he writes is about how he figured it out or whatever and and then he's never sort of found again.
tellings.difference: Dated 1994 rather than 1995. It adds that his last note said he had figured it out, and credits Alex Gomez-Marin.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Jacobo Grinberg disappearing in the 1990s, and both tie it to Puharich.

as_told.title: Jacobo Grinberg vanishes after saying he figured it out
